text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT - elevated 5xx + timeouts on inference-gateway detected at 2026-03-15T12:07Z. p95 jumped ~120ms -> ~3.4s, p99 ~12s. 5xx rate rose to ~6.8% across eastus cluster. Potential deploy correlation (deploy-20260315-1200). Auto-fallback did not trigger cleanly. Paging on-call now.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. pulling logs and traces. starting timeline.

der-ops: @sre-oncall what's the scope? internal-only or customer-facing?

erin: Customer-facing — we see increased retries from lots of customers. A few partners reported timeouts. Putting customer-impact tag.

tim: Any recent changes besides deploy? routing, infra?

alisha: Only main thing is the new gateway concurrency patch in the deploy at 12:00. I can check the commit that touched kv-cache and multiplexing.

sre-oncall: Confirmed: deploy-bot shows deploy-20260315-1200 -> gateway image: rinf-gateway:v3.4. Logs show a spike in `accept loop` latencies and repeated `context.DeadlineExceeded` in callproxy.

incident-bot: Automated note: 3 alerts fired: gateway-timeout-high, api-5xx-rate, p99-latency-cliff. Correlation score 0.87 with latest deploy.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed at 2026-03-15T12:00Z: services: inference-gateway, sidecar-kvcache. Canary percent 100 (rolling).

meera: Can someone post a short `kubectl` snippet to see rollout status?

alisha: `kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/inference-gateway`

erin: I'm going to check tracing for a sample failed request. Trace id: `trace-0a1b2c3d`.

sre-oncall: Paste from logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-15T12:06:43Z gateway[inference-gateway] INFO accept request id=... cost=5ms
2026-03-15T12:06:44Z gateway[inference-gateway] WARN backend call timeout after 2500ms id=... target=kvcache
2026-03-15T12:07:12Z gateway[inference-gateway] ERROR context.DeadlineExceeded handler=proxy req=... duration=12.3s
2026-03-15T12:07:13Z gateway[inference-gateway] ERROR downstream 502 path=/v1/generate pid=...\n```

ops-lead: Looks like kvcache calls are blocking and pushing requests past request deadline. Could be a regression in multiplexing or new kernel flags.

alisha: I can revert the multiplexing change in the image build quickly if we decide to rollback.

erin: Timeline so far: deploy at 12:00 -> errors spike at ~12:06 -> pager at 12:07 -> now 12:09. Need mitigation within 15 mins. Suggest rolling back to `rinf-gateway:v3.3`.

sre-oncall: Agreed. Does anyone need a brief canary? given impact, prefer full rollback to fix customer-facing errors.

ops-lead: +1 full rollback. Callout to support to draft customer comms if it persists.

meera: I'll run the rollback now. Command: `rcli deploy set-image inference-gateway rinf-gateway:v3.3 --namespace prod`

alisha: Copy that. Tagging build that caused issue: `rinf-gateway:v3.4` -> `commit 9f3b` touched multiplexing flags.

deploy-bot: Rollback trigger accepted. Rolling to rinf-gateway:v3.3. Starting rolling restart.

incident-bot: Note: scaling policy temporarily increased replicas to 20 to help drain queue while rollback happens.

erin: Quick check: enabling `kvcache` short-circuit fallback as temporary mitigation. Command: `curl -XPOST https://admin.prod/prefs -d '{"kvcache_short_circuit":true}'` (ops approved).

meera: Health probes after 60s: 12/20 pods ready, new pods are coming up.

sre-oncall: Observability: p95 down to 1.1s within 2 minutes of rollback start, p99 dropping but still noisy. 5xx rate falling from 6.8% -> 1.9% over last 4 minutes.

alisha: Re-deploying old image succeeded on all nodes. No crashloops observed.

tim: Are there any queued requests that will continue failing? retries are increasing - should we throttle clients?

erin: We're enabling a short-term 2s global request timeout gateway-side and instructing clients to retry at 1xx backoff. Doing that now: `POST /admin/config` payload `{"request_timeout_ms":2000}`

ops-lead: Support: please flag any VIP customers with timeouts so we can offer post-incident credits.

sre-oncall: Handing off active watch to meera for stabilization and postmortem writeup. I'll remain available for questions.

meera: Watching metrics. Last sample: p95=320ms, p99=980ms, 5xx=0.4% (stable 3m). Marking mitigation: rollback completed at 2026-03-15T12:18Z.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> under monitoring. Initial severity: Sev2 (customer-facing but partial impact).

erin: Action items: 1) postmortem draft (meera + erin), 2) revert commit `9f3b` from main branch and add e2e for kvcache/multiplexing (alisha), 3) add canary gating for gateway concurrency in rollout pipeline (sre team).

meera: I'll open the postmortem ticket and link traces + timeline. @ops-lead please collect customer reports and support tickets for impact quantification.

ops-lead: on it. Notifying account reps for customers who reported timeouts.

tim: Thx everyone. Please ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Leaving watch to meera at 2026-03-15T12:25Z. If p99 spikes above 2s again, page on-call.

meera: A few follow-ups I already started: metric alert tuning for kvcache latency, add synthetic traffic to canary, and add an automated rollback if p99 > 3s within 5m of deploy.

erin: Good notes. Closing active thread when postmortem is attached.

incident-bot: Incident closed for active mitigation. Please file postmortem within 72 hours and mark severity final in ticket.
